description: SP ENW - Network Data - Network Asset Viewer is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Application Classification - Open SP ENW - Network Data - Network Asset Viewer Interactive web map showing the location, connectivity and details of SP Electricity North West assets, overlaid on an OpenStreetMap base map. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Reference Data. Its keywords are Network, NAV, Network Asset Viewer. The portal shows 2026-06-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
